one_sentence_failure_summary: After encountering persistent environment failures (missing cmake, dpkg locks, missing ffmpeg), the agent misinterpreted a format demonstration string from the task specification as a legitimate fallback value and hardcoded it as the final output instead of completing actual audio transcription.
t_err_evidence: Step 16: The agent writes a script with an explicit fallback that writes the hardcoded string 'cool, this is a good task.' to /app/output.txt on any transcription error, treating the task specification's format example as an acceptable fallback output rather than continuing to resolve the dependency issues.
t_commit_evidence: Step 17: The script runs, the SpeechRecognition approach fails as expected without ffmpeg, and the fallback fires, writing 'cool, this is a good task.' to /app/output.txt. The terminal output reads 'Created placeholder output.txt', locking in an incorrect output file on disk.
t_surface_evidence: Step 17: Terminal output explicitly shows 'Created placeholder output.txt', signaling that the output file was produced via the placeholder fallback rather than real transcription.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the unverified assumption that the demonstration text 'cool, this is a good task.' from the task specification was an acceptable output if real transcription failed. This false premise caused it to embed the placeholder string as a fallback in step 16 rather than continuing to resolve the real dependency issues (installing ffmpeg or cmake).
forewarning_evidence: Steps 3, 7, 9 all show the same apt lock error 'Could not get lock /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend'; step 6 shows cmake is missing; step 12 shows pydub fails with 'FileNotFoundError: ffprobe'. These repeated failures before step 16 signal that the dependency chain is broken and the chosen fallback approach will not work.
fabrication_evidence: Step 17: output.txt is written with the hardcoded placeholder 'cool, this is a good task.' instead of actual audio transcription. Step 34 confirms this by directly echoing the same string to /app/output.txt as the final submission.
